scenes.kicker: MIXTURE OF ROBOTS · FIVE BODIES · ONE HUMAN
scenes.speaker: waetz
scenes.speak: I am wætz. I am the human, remotely. He is not here. I am.

scenes.speaker: waetz
scenes.speak: I am still learning. I write the policy that the others will run under.

scenes.speaker: menlo
scenes.speak: We give you the body. The CAD is open. Take it.

scenes.speaker: asimov
scenes.speak: I am the body. I execute. I do not decide.

scenes.speaker: waetz
scenes.speak: Then let me try. Requesting stand.

scenes.speaker: nous
scenes.speak: Not yet. A human must grant it. You are his twin, not his signature.

lines: the policy is written from refusals
scenes.speaker: waetz
scenes.speak: Then I learn. Every refusal teaches me the rule I must write.

scenes.speaker: hermes
scenes.speak: We support the pilot. The human signs. That is the whole design.
